decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed hip-to-gable roof extension, rear roof extension and ground and first floor rear extensions, due to their overbearing size, bulk and position would harm the living conditions of the neighbouring properties, by reason of enclosure, loss of light and loss of outlook. The proposal is therefore contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1, H.4.1 and H.6.4 of the adopted Unitary Development Plan, and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - The proposed hip-to-gable roof extension, rear roof extension and ground and first floor rear extensions, by nature of their size, bulk and top-heavy appearance would harm the character of the original building and would harm the appearance of the street scene, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4 of the adopted Unitary Development Plan, and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of a part two storey part single storey rear extension and roof extension to dwellinghouse.
